children: When building systems on top of web APIs, performance is critical. Compression is an easy and effective way to reduce the size and increase the speed of communication between a client and remote resource.
Two common compression algorithms used on the web are GZip and Deflate. The Accept-Encoding header is used by a client to restrict the encoding types that are acceptable in the response.
